desc: The Sledgehammer Omni-Buster AR-15 Charging Handle is engineered for shooters running suppressed rifles who demand reliable gas mitigation without oversized controls. Its internal gas-management system delivers three integrated gas-reducing features for both left and right-handed shooters, significantly minimizing blowback at the shooter’s face when running unsuppressed or suppressed. The Omni-Buster features a balanced ambidextrous design with robust serrated latches for confident manipulation under stress.
